usage: tr retrieval [-h] {build,query,eval} ...

positional arguments:
  {build,query,eval}
    build             fetch 8-K earnings and 10-Q text from SEC Archives,
                      chunk, index
    query             top chunks for a question, nothing after the session
                      close
    eval              recall@k of labelled queries (no calls)

options:
  -h, --help          show this help message and exit
